text: Implementation and performance are monitored using social indicators including workforce composition by age, gender and geographical area; women’s representation among the top 10% of management; recruitment and departures; sickness and workplace-accident absenteeism; workplace-accident frequency and severity rates; training hours per employee; employees with disabilities; and collective agreements signed.
Air France-KLM monitors workforce-policy performance using workplace-accident severity rates as a social indicator.
